claims.claim_text: The Richerson and Rickerson index rows represent the same Roy K. Rickerson, documented as an OSS lieutenant in France and captain in China.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The two index rows share one protected identifier; official Army and NPS histories use Rickerson and show the matching rank progression.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed: exact protected-identifier agreement across both source rows plus official name, unit, and rank-progression evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: The evidence establishes wartime OSS identity and progression from lieutenant to captain, but not a pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: Both immutable index rows remain visible; Richerson is retained as a documented spelling variant. No employer is inferred from wartime service.
